FAQ

Answers to what I get asked the most.

What if I want to commission a drawing in one of your styles not currently listed?

Ask me about it in DMs and we can discuss possibilities and pricing etc. I will most likely not agree to drawing in my more realistic style at the moment, though, since they take too much time.

Are prices negotiable?

To a certain extent, yes. I understand that these prices are unaffordable to people from third world countries, so I am always willing to discuss possible discounts in those cases. I will however NOT be doing free commissions! Those are called art requests, and you can drop those on my StrawPage.

Are there things you will not draw?

I try to know my limits, both for my own sake and that of customers. I might turn down complex perspectives or very complicated backgrounds that I cannot currently draw (well). I also do not draw NSFW content, political themes/dogwhistles, furries/animals, or excessive blood & violence (gore). Things that somewhat touch on online political culture are usually okay, such as a character wearing a "nothing ever happens shirt" or doing the Soyjak pointing pose. But I will not draw Mymy holding hands with Chudjak.

How long will it take?

It depends on the style and complexity, but I will always give you an estimation beforehand and will let you know when there's a delay.

How does payment work?

I accept both half up front & half after, and full up front payment. For privacy reasons, I prefer being paid through ko-fi. If your country doesn't support that platform, we can discuss other ways of sending me the money.

How much do you charge extra for accessories such as phones or guns or such?

I usually count them as part of the background and will price them according to their complexity. Usually I will count them as part of a "simple background".

Where do I message you about commissions?

Preferably Twitter DMs, but Discord is also okay. Do know that I might remove you as a friend post-commission, please don't take that personally. I just use Discord DMs mostly for friends and have it open all the time, so I am very selective about who I open my DMs for outside of business/mod stuff.

Pricing

Every style comes in full color or line art, priced by how much of the character is shown.

Calculate your commission price

A rough, just-for-fun estimate, not a formal quote. Message me to confirm the real price!

Detailed backgrounds are a full color only service — line art pieces can still get a flat/gradient/pattern backdrop at no extra cost.

Estimated total $0

Estimate only! Prices can be a little negotiable (see the FAQ above) and anything unusual I haven't accounted for here may change the final price.
